phase_name: Test suite for the recap script

objectives.description: Register suite in suite-classification.data and manifest.json
Fix a real bug in orchestrate-recap.sh's find_newest() surfaced by Case 4

approaches_tried.approach: Ran the new suite with default (deploy-tree-first) subject resolution
approaches_tried.reason: resolved the DEPLOYED (stale) copy of lib/runtime-file-patterns.sh, which predates Phase 1's new runtime_recap_path() resolver -- 'command not found'. Fixed by running with CORE_TEST_SUBJECT_MODE=source-store during development, ahead of Phase 5's redeploy, per the resolver's own printed guidance.

approaches_tried.approach: Case 4 (neither recap file nor meta file present) against a freshly-built sandbox with no prior --write call
approaches_tried.reason: exposed a REAL bug: find_newest()'s `find "$dir" ...` exits non-zero when $dir (specs/.orchestration/) was never created at all (distinct from an existing-but-empty directory, which find handles fine) -- under pipefail this non-zero propagated and set -e aborted the whole script before it could ever print the generic fallback sentence. Fixed by adding a `[ -d "$dir" ] || return 0` guard at the top of find_newest() in orchestrate-recap.sh.

approaches_tried.approach: Cases 7 and 9 (piper-absent / paplay-absent) using a PATH of '<fakebin>:<real PATH>'
approaches_tried.reason: the authoring host genuinely has real piper, paplay, and espeak-ng installed system-wide, so 'absent from PATH' cases silently resolved the real binaries instead of exercising the intended absence branch -- Case 7 passed for the wrong reason (espeak-ng is never called by the script on ANY branch, so its assertion held regardless) and Case 9 failed outright (real paplay let real piper actually get invoked). Fixed by making each case's bin directory fully self-contained (every CORE_DEPS coreutil symlinked in from the real PATH once, plus only the fake audio binaries each case explicitly requests) and setting PATH to ONLY that directory with no real-PATH fallback -- a binary build_fakebin did not place there is now genuinely unreachable.

deviations.description: Added a ninth test case (paplay absent, piper present -> prints+exit 0, piper never invoked) beyond the eight explicit 'Case:' bullets in the plan's task list
deviations.reason: The phase's own Goal and the plan's Research Integration section both describe a 'nine-case test suite', but only eight distinct Case: bullets are enumerated in the task list. Added a ninth case exercising the paplay-absence safety branch (an additive guard beyond the plan's three documented no-audio conditions, already noted as a Phase 1 deviation) to reconcile the stated case count with the enumerated list.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- added a ninth case not explicitly enumerated, to match the phase's own stated case count)*
